data.one_liner: Cache Base64 or Uint8List images locally and display them with a widget or provider
data.what_it_does: It stores images encoded as Base64 or raw bytes in the device cache directory and serves them via a widget or ImageProvider. It also provides utilities to check existence, remove, clear and dispose cache entries.
use_when: You need to display images that are only available as Base64 or byte arrays and want them cached locally
You want a simple widget or provider that handles caching automatically without writing file I/O code
avoid_when: You need to stream large images from a network source
You require advanced image manipulation or decoding beyond simple caching
strengths: Supports both Base64 and Uint8List inputs
Built on flutter_cache_manager for reliable caching
Provides utility methods for cache management
weaknesses: Limited to Base64/Uint8List, not network images
No support for SVG or vector graphics
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package
